text:
Hello to front line,
The lounge attendant sent an update on rest areas.

Thank you for the careful note and for keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk informed. The report was helpful, especially where travelers with pets may need calm waiting space and clear direction before boarding. Please continue to pass along any changes in seating flow, cleaning status, or support needs so that records stay current and our replies remain consistent and respectful. The cabin team relies on this information to support animals during flight, and the welcome team benefits as well when preparing passengers for boarding.

For today's internal follow-up, please remind staff to keep tone steady and to document any concerns in plain language. If a traveler reports a missed connection, <<FACT F116>>. If there is a lost crate report, <<FACT F112>>. These items should be shared exactly as written in the case record so the file remains complete and easy to review later. When speaking with travelers, we should keep the exchange warm, brief, and focused on next steps, while avoiding any extra detail that could confuse the record.

Thank you for helping maintain prompt and respectful communication across the desk. Clear notes from the lounge make it easier for us to support travelers and their companions with care, and that support reflects well on Aurelia Skyways. Please send any further updates through the usual channel so the team can respond with accuracy and patience.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
